newsitem.title: FINLAND: Amer K-owners cancel deal with Moyne-paper.
newsitem.headline: Amer K-owners cancel deal with Moyne-paper.

text.p: Three of the four institutions owning vote-heavy K-shares in Finnish sporting goods group Amer-yhtyma Oy have cancelled their agreement to sell shares to British investor Lord Moyne, Finnish newspapers reported on Monday.

Representatives of the K-shareholders declined to comment on the reason for the cancellation, daily Helsingin Sanomat said. It said Lord Moyne's financing arrangements had not satisfied the sellers, but gave no source.
The deal would have given Jonathan Bryan Guinness, the third Lord Moyne, over 58 percent of votes in Amer. He offered on June 2 to buy 1.1 million K-shares for 301 million markka.
